feedback: The people generally sound distinct under pressure. Artie counting chairs, Frank obsessing about a chair position, and Al asking to call home work especially well because their attention slips toward habits and actual responsibilities. Reed and Claire have an engaging strained relationship, and Brie and Barb protecting staff make them more than occupational suspects. The central poisoning route is solvable before voting: exposed source, unattended individual glass, clean communal supply, and an access-denying statement contradicted by independently retained images. I appreciate that the band scrap is explicitly similar stock rather than falsely treated as an exact forensic match. The event feels plausible locally, though the full cast creates a conspicuously assembled pattern: practically everyone has a concealed professional compromise, a donor conflict, and a precisely retained correction. Much of the final round sounds like testimony responding to a technical checklist. It remains emotionally effective, but the large number of parallel files dilutes momentum. I found no contradiction that defeats the core solution; the certainty comes from converging evidence and the consequential lie rather than exclusive physical access.
